content: Elbasvir/grazoprevir is indicated for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years or older, or weighing at least 30 kg. It is specifically used for HCV genotypes 1 or 4. In certain patient populations, it may be co-administered with ribavirin. The treatment duration and the decision to use ribavirin depend on the HCV genotype and other patient-specific factors. The standard dosage is one tablet taken orally once daily. Drug Interactions and Contraindications: 1. Atazanavir: Co-administration with atazanavir is contraindicated as it increases elbasvir/grazoprevir levels, potentially leading to elevated ALT levels due to significant increases in grazoprevir plasma concentrations. 2. Carbamazepine: Contraindicated because it decreases elbasvir/grazoprevir levels by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing therapeutic efficacy. 3.
